title: Hodl payment
tagline: with Hodle Payment you can stake your Etheruem in Aave protocol and send(spend) GHO token to any address that you want this way you will spend the price of ETH and later when ETH goes higher you can unlock your ETH
description:
with Hodle Payment you can stake your Etheruem in Aave protocol and send(spend) GHO token to any address that you want this way you will spend the price of ETH and later when ETH goes higher you can unlock your ETH 
we used connect kit to connect users to the app 
Front-end built with React using Vite 
all transactions are built with contract-helper package of aave
how_its_made:
we used connect kit to connect users to the app 
Front-end built with React using Vite 
all transactions are built with contract-helpers package of aave
it is published using github pages 
and we also built a custom hook for extracting ethers provider from connect kit 
this way we can use connect kit for using aave contract helpers
